question: Which additional materials must be included in the preparation at this stage?
premises: The five parts of paribhadra are used.
The inclusion is repeated in the same manner.
inference: The preparation must include the five parts of paribhadra and kakini as well.
uncertainties: The identity of kakini in this ritual context is not specified.
plain_english: Take the five parts of the paribhadra and also kakini, likewise again.
